# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC22 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

## Scope

RC22 adds a streamlined default-task shortcut for the common IDE check/test/build loop while preserving the existing trust boundary.

- `Esc t d` opens Run Default Task.
- `:task-default`, `:default-task`, `:run-default`, and `:check` open the same flow.
- Default resolution prefers `check`, then `test`, `build`, `lint`, and `fmt`.
- If no conventional task exists and exactly one task is configured, that one is selected.
- If several non-conventional tasks exist, the task picker opens instead of guessing.
- The shortcut never starts a task directly. It enters the existing Task Trust prompt, where `V` opens read-only details, `Y` trusts once and runs, and `Esc` cancels.
- Existing running-task refusal still applies.

## Proof boundary
